title: 黄仁勋被三问：是否违法？是否间谍？，芯片管制被绕过？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The president appears to have given some form of guarantee to the board over the weekend.
segments.zh: 总统似乎在上周末向董事会提供了某种保证。

segments.en: Is this case closed? Well, by no means is it closed.
segments.zh: 这个案子结了吗？远未结束。

segments.en: I mean, let me start by saying, really, what a tragedy. We had one of the greatest, most innovative companies in the history of the world.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，首先不得不说，这真是一场悲剧。我们曾拥有世界上历史上最伟大、最具创新性的公司之一。

segments.en: Jensen has been an incredibly successful entrepreneur, but these allegations and charges are incredibly serious.
segments.zh: Jensen是一位极其成功的企业家，但这些指控和罪名极其严重。

segments.en: And I have the same questions whether Jensen is the CEO or not the CEO.
segments.zh: 无论Jensen是否担任CEO，我都有同样的疑问。

segments.en: And when he comes before the bank committee, there's three things that I want to know.
segments.zh: 当他来到银行委员会时，我想知道三件事。

segments.en: Number one, were any laws broken?
segments.zh: 第一，是否违反了任何法律？

segments.en: Number two was national security compromised by this relationship with this woman.
segments.zh: 第二，与这名女子的关系是否危及了国家安全？

segments.en: Was she, in fact, a Chinese spy? And third, were the commerce rules, the Department of Commerce rules, circumvented to get these
segments.zh: 她实际上是中国间谍吗？第三，是否绕过了商务部规则，通过这些

segments.en: most advanced chips in the hands of the Chinese through remote access or through other means.
segments.zh: 最先进的芯片通过远程访问或其他方式落入中国手中。

segments.en: And those are really serious questions to our national security. This AI race with China is one we need to win, and part of winning is making sure that
segments.zh: 这些对我们国家安全是真正严峻的问题。与中国的AI竞赛我们必须赢，而赢的一部分就是确保

segments.en: these most advanced chips, which is a real advantage for America, aren't in the hands of the Chinese.
segments.zh: 这些最先进的芯片，是美国的真正优势，不能落入中国人手中。

segments.en: I'll say one more word, which is this also absolutely reinforces what I and a number of other members of the Senate have been saying, which is we need more legislation to restrict
segments.zh: 我还要说一点，这也绝对印证了我和参议院其他一些成员一直在说的，我们需要更多立法来限制

segments.en: the export of these most advanced chips.
segments.zh: 这些最先进芯片的出口。
